tool_schemas.name: list_inboxes
tool_schemas.description: Lists inboxes in your AgentMail account and returns a paged result set using limit and an opaque cursor for the next page, optionally filtered by provider, status, and sync_state and sorted by the requested field and order. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if limit is not an integer, if cursor is malformed, or if provider/status/sync_state/sort/order are not one of the allowed values. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the caller is not authenticated, FORBIDDEN if the caller is not allowed to list inboxes for the account, and RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded.

limit.description: Maximum number of inboxes to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for fetching the next page.

tool_schemas.name: get_inbox
tool_schemas.description: Retrieves a single inbox by inbox_id and returns the inbox resource. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if inbox_id does not match the expected am_inbox_… format. Raises NOT_FOUND if no inbox exists with that id, UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot access it, and RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded.

tool_schemas.name: create_inbox
tool_schemas.description: Creates (provisions or connects) an inbox for the specified provider and returns the newly created inbox resource. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if required fields are missing, provider is not supported, metadata is not an object, or email_address/display_name are not strings; it may also reject provider/email_address combinations that are not acceptable for provisioning. Raises CONFLICT if an inbox already exists for the same provider/email_address (when provided), UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot create inboxes for the account, and RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded.

provider.description: Provider used to provision/connect the inbox.

email_address.description: Email address for the inbox (may be assigned/validated by provider).

metadata.description: Arbitrary metadata to store on the inbox.

tool_schemas.name: list_threads
tool_schemas.description: Lists conversation threads for a single inbox and returns a paged result set using limit and an opaque cursor, optionally filtered by status and sorted by the requested field and order. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if inbox_id is not in am_inbox_… format or if status/sort/order/cursor/limit are invalid, and NOT_FOUND if the inbox does not exist. Raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot access the inbox, and RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded.

inbox_id.description: Inbox id to list threads for.

limit.description: Maximum number of threads to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for fetching the next page.

tool_schemas.name: list_all_threads
tool_schemas.description: Lists conversation threads across all inboxes in your AgentMail account and returns a paged result set using limit and an opaque cursor, optionally filtered by status and sorted by the requested field and order. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if status/sort/order/cursor/limit are invalid. Raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot list threads for the account, and RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded.

limit.description: Maximum number of threads to return across all inboxes.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for fetching the next page.

tool_schemas.name: get_thread
tool_schemas.description: Retrieves a single thread by thread_id and returns the thread resource. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if thread_id does not match the expected am_th_… format. Raises NOT_FOUND if the thread does not exist, UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot access the thread, and RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded.

tool_schemas.name: list_messages
tool_schemas.description: Lists messages in a single inbox and returns a paged result set using limit and an opaque cursor; results can be restricted to a thread_id and filtered by direction, status, and is_read, then sorted by the requested field and order. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if inbox_id/thread_id do not match expected formats or if direction/status/is_read/sort/order/cursor/limit are invalid, and NOT_FOUND if the inbox does not exist or if a provided thread_id does not exist. Raises FORBIDDEN if the thread_id does not belong to the specified inbox, plus UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN for access control failures and RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded.

inbox_id.description: Inbox id to list messages for.

thread_id.description: Optional thread id to restrict results to a single thread.

limit.description: Maximum number of messages to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for fetching the next page.

tool_schemas.name: get_message
tool_schemas.description: Retrieves a single message by message_id and returns the message resource. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if message_id does not match the expected am_msg_… format. Raises NOT_FOUND if the message does not exist, UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot access the message, and RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded.

tool_schemas.name: send_message
tool_schemas.description: Sends an outbound message from the specified inbox (optionally associating it with an existing thread) and returns the created outbound message record. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if inbox_id (and thread_id when provided) are not in the expected formats, if to_emails is missing/empty or not an array of strings, or if other provided fields are of the wrong type; it also rejects requests with no body_text and no body_html. Raises NOT_FOUND if the inbox does not exist or if the provided thread_id does not exist, CONFLICT if the inbox is not in a send-capable state (for example provisioning/paused/disabled/error) or the provider connection is not ready, plus UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN for access control failures and RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded.

inbox_id.description: ID of the inbox to send the message from.

thread_id.description: Optional thread ID to associate the outbound message with.

from_email.description: From email address for the outbound message.

to_emails.description: List of primary recipient email addresses.

cc_emails.description: List of CC recipient email addresses.

bcc_emails.description: List of BCC recipient email addresses.

headers.description: Additional RFC-822 style headers to attach to the outbound message.

labels.description: Provider labels/tags to apply to the message.

tool_schemas.name: reply_to_message
tool_schemas.description: Creates and sends an outbound reply from the specified inbox to an existing message and returns the created reply message record. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if inbox_id/message_id are not in the expected formats or if provided recipient/body/header fields are invalid; it also rejects requests with no body_text and no body_html. Raises NOT_FOUND if the inbox or original message does not exist, CONFLICT if the inbox is not in a send-capable state or the original message cannot be replied to in its current status, plus UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN for access control failures and RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded.

inbox_id.description: ID of the inbox to send the reply from.

message_id.description: ID of the message being replied to.

from_email.description: From email address for the reply.

to_emails.description: Override list of primary recipients for the reply.

cc_emails.description: List of CC recipient email addresses for the reply.

bcc_emails.description: List of BCC recipient email addresses for the reply.

subject.description: Subject line for the reply (defaults to the original thread subject).

headers.description: Additional headers to attach to the reply.

labels.description: Provider labels/tags to apply to the reply message.

tool_schemas.name: update_message
tool_schemas.description: Update mutable fields on an existing message (for example, mark read/unread, replace the message’s label set, or update its status) and return the updated message. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if message_id does not match the required format or if any provided field value is invalid (including an unknown status), NOT_FOUND if the message_id does not exist, and FORBIDDEN/UNAUTHORIZED if you do not have access to the owning inbox. Raises CONFLICT if the requested status transition is not allowed for the message’s current state (for example, attempting to move a deleted message back to sent).

message_id.description: ID of the message to update.

is_read.description: Whether the message is marked as read.

labels.description: Full set of labels/tags to store on the message.

tool_schemas.name: list_drafts
tool_schemas.description: List drafts for a single inbox, optionally filtered by thread_id and/or status, and return a page of draft records sorted by sort_by and sort_order. Results are paginated with limit (1–200) and an opaque cursor; the response includes a next_cursor when more results are available. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid IDs, invalid enum values, or out-of-range limit, NOT_FOUND if the inbox_id does not exist (or thread_id is specified but does not exist in that inbox), and FORBIDDEN/UNAUTHORIZED if you are not permitted to read drafts for the inbox.

inbox_id.description: ID of the inbox to list drafts for.

thread_id.description: Filter drafts to a specific thread.

limit.description: Maximum number of drafts to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for the next page.

tool_schemas.name: list_all_drafts
tool_schemas.description: List drafts across all inboxes in the AgentMail account, optionally filtered by status, and return a page of draft records sorted by sort_by and sort_order. Results are paginated with limit (1–200) and an opaque cursor; the response includes a next_cursor when more results are available. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid enum values or out-of-range limit and FORBIDDEN/UNAUTHORIZED if your account is not allowed to list drafts.

limit.description: Maximum number of drafts to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for the next page.

tool_schemas.name: get_draft
tool_schemas.description: Retrieve a single draft by draft_id and return the full draft record. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if draft_id does not match the required format, NOT_FOUND if no such draft exists, and FORBIDDEN/UNAUTHORIZED if you do not have access to the draft’s inbox.

draft_id.description: ID of the draft to retrieve.

tool_schemas.name: create_draft
tool_schemas.description: Create a new draft in the specified inbox (optionally associated to a thread and/or a reply_to_message_id) and return the created draft record. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if inbox_id/thread_id/reply_to_message_id formats are invalid, if provided fields are the wrong type, or if both body_text and body_html are omitted while other sendable fields are provided inconsistently, NOT_FOUND if the inbox does not exist (or if thread_id/reply_to_message_id are provided but do not exist in that inbox), and FORBIDDEN/UNAUTHORIZED if you cannot create drafts in the inbox. Raises CONFLICT if reply_to_message_id is provided but does not belong to the given thread_id (when both are provided).

inbox_id.description: ID of the inbox to create the draft in.

thread_id.description: Optional thread ID to associate the draft with.

reply_to_message_id.description: Optional message ID this draft is replying to.

from_email.description: From email address for the draft.

to_emails.description: List of primary recipient email addresses.

cc_emails.description: List of CC recipient email addresses.

bcc_emails.description: List of BCC recipient email addresses.

headers.description: Additional headers to attach to the draft.

tool_schemas.name: send_draft
tool_schemas.description: Queue a draft for delivery and return the updated draft (typically transitioning from draft to sending, and later to sent or error). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if draft_id does not match the required format, NOT_FOUND if the draft does not exist, and FORBIDDEN/UNAUTHORIZED if you do not have permission to send from the draft’s inbox. Raises CONFLICT if the draft is not in a sendable state (for example, already sent, discarded, or currently sending).

draft_id.description: ID of the draft to send.

tool_schemas.name: update_inbox
tool_schemas.description: Updates mutable fields on an inbox (display_name, metadata, and/or status) and returns the updated inbox. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if inbox_id is invalid, if no writable fields are provided, if metadata is not an object, or if status is not one of the allowed values. Raises CONFLICT if the requested status transition is not permitted by the inbox lifecycle. Raises NOT_FOUND if the inbox does not exist, UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot access it, and RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded.

metadata.description: Arbitrary metadata to store on the inbox.

status.description: Requested inbox status; must follow allowed lifecycle transitions.

tool_schemas.name: update_thread
tool_schemas.description: Updates mutable fields on a thread (status) and returns the updated thread. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if thread_id is invalid or if status is not one of the allowed values. Raises CONFLICT if the requested status transition is not permitted by the thread lifecycle. Raises NOT_FOUND if the thread does not exist, UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot access the thread's inbox, and RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded.

status.description: Requested thread status; must follow allowed lifecycle transitions.

tool_schemas.name: update_draft
tool_schemas.description: Updates a draft (recipients, subject, body, headers, metadata fields) while it is in a writable state and returns the updated draft. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if draft_id is invalid, if no writable fields are provided, if recipients arrays contain non-strings, or if headers is not an object. Raises CONFLICT if the draft is not in a writable status (e.g., sent or discarded) or if an attempted status transition is not permitted. Raises NOT_FOUND if the draft does not exist, UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot access the draft's inbox, and RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded.

headers.description: Additional RFC822-style headers to include when sending.

status.description: Requested draft status; only lifecycle-allowed transitions are permitted (e.g., draft->discarded).
